Taylor’s [broken symbolon and tessera](../../../mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/taylor-authored-images/WHOLE.md#broken-symbolon-tessera) **figures** an absent counterpart remaining operative through the present half’s seam. This authored return preserves the distinct One/All offices and keeps Greek institutional history as its own source task.
